OPTIONAL / TWO WEEKS BEFORE THE EVENT

Build your prototype.
Then present it.

Apply to join a two-week build sprint before Moonshot Rodeo.

Use focused build time, access to shared tools, and expert support to push your project forward. Bring your own materials: participants source and fund their own parts and components; the sprint provides workspace, shared tools, and expert support. At the event, present and defend what you built alongside participants bringing existing projects or presenting field solutions.

Apply for the sprintAlready have a prototype?

HOW IT WORKS

Apply, build,
and present.

Apply with your project.

Tell Arrowhead what you want to build and what shared tools or advice would help.

Join the two-week sprint.

Use the build period before the event to develop your prototype with focused time and support.

Present and defend your prototype.

Participants defend their prototype to a panel of experts in engineering, research, and industry, who question the design and give structured feedback.

All three ways to present share the same stage: join the Build Sprint, bring an existing project, or present a Field Solution.

Return to Moonshot Rodeo

Bring Your Own

This track is for participants who already have a prototype and want to present that project at Moonshot Rodeo without joining the two-week Build Sprint.

Bring the project you already have. You do not need to build it during the sprint.

At the event, you present your work and defend your approach to a panel of experts in engineering, research, and industry, who question the approach and give structured feedback. All three ways to present share the same stage and expert panel.

To apply, email Arrowhead Research with a short description of your project. Moonshot Rodeo is February 4, 2027. Submission details are to be confirmed.

Apply by email

Field Solutions

This track is for presentations that may not be a physical prototype. We welcome creative solutions to real problems in the field, such as workarounds, processes, tactics, or improvised tools. If you solved something hard, it fits.

Prepare to walk the panel through your thinking: how you solved the problem and why you approached it that way. You do not need a physical device.

At the event, you present your field solution and defend your approach to the same expert panel as the other tracks. All three ways to present share the same stage and expert panel.

To apply, email Arrowhead Research. Moonshot Rodeo is February 4, 2027. Submission details are to be confirmed.
